promotion_rule: runtime_authority_enabled may become true only after every required_gate is independently evidenced PASS; until then GitHub continuity metadata is the operational governance checkpoint but is not an executable Runtime-state substitute
notes: GitHub main is the canonical code/rule and Continuity governance authority.
Notion and Google Drive are no longer operating-control authorities; they may supply source, knowledge, artifact or migration-mirror inputs only.
When runtime_authority_enabled=false, TASK_MANIFEST/HANDOFF on GitHub main carry governance-stage, next-action and evidence-reference state; they do not impersonate the owner Runtime state machine.
A Runtime checkpoint becomes executable market-day task authority only after the promotion gates pass and runtime_authority_enabled=true.
Changing this file does not itself prove a Runtime gate; attach replay/E2E/durability evidence before Runtime promotion.
